a.lede: The company is suspending the feature after security researchers discovered how easy it was to access sensitive information shared with the AI assistant.
a.title: A Design Flaw in Share Links Exposes Users’ Personal Conversations With Meta’s Muse

b.lede: Meta says it paused a Muse feature that lets you share conversations with the AI assistant after researchers found the URLs publicly available on the web, as reported by Ars Technica. In a report published this week, researchers at the security firm Claroc say they found more than 6,800 Muse links through public DNS records. […]
b.title: Meta pauses Muse sharing after researchers find AI chats on the web
